intended_object: A smart constructor that turns a morphism p : X ⟶ S into an object of the library's bundled type DenseOpenRationalSchemeOver S, i.e. it regards X as an S-scheme via p (from the docstring and the structure definition).
explanation: The structure DenseOpenRationalSchemeOver S just bundles a scheme with an arbitrary morphism to S, and `of p := ⟨X, p⟩` is its anonymous constructor with the morphism as the only argument. It is a packaging convenience for the library's own structure; the mathematical content of the file (dense-open-pulling rational maps over S) is in `Hom`. It does what it says: it puts no condition on p, which matches the module docs, and the rfl simp lemmas toScheme_of and toBase_of confirm it. Mathematically it is the same as forming Over.mk p, but as a definition it is an implementation device rather than a separate mathematical object.
